_comment: DogPull settings. `destination: null` means <RM drive>/DogPull/<folderName>. Set it to an absolute path to pull onto an external drive instead.
_channelConfirmed: @XanderBudnick confirmed by Garrett as the correct channel.
_qualityNote: 1080p30, preferring H.264 video with AAC audio — the combination CapCut, Premiere and Resolve handle most smoothly. H.264 only exists up to 1080p on YouTube, so this preference is only valid at this height; DogPull automatically falls back to VP9 if height is raised above 1080.
label: Xander Budnick
